01 / THE BENCHMARK

Manipulation with
something to reason about.

Picking up an object is only part of the problem. These tasks make the relationships between actions matter: what is hidden, what has changed, what remains, and what must come first.

Each family contains four single-arm and four dual-arm tasks. Task metrics, action replay, human review and policy performance are recorded as separate measures.

TRAINING DATA

The LeRobot release

Standard LeRobot v3.0 roots with Parquet signals, MP4 camera streams, instructions, statistics, controller metadata and validation reports. Hosted in a private GitHub repository.

Open GitHub repository ↗Repository access and Git LFS are required.
↗

TASK RECORDING & DEVELOPMENT HISTORY

The task-record archive

Google Drive keeps track of task recordings, scenes, assets, provenance and development documents. Its 20 dual-arm manifests list 50 trajectories each, with five selected review videos uploaded per task. This archive is separate from the LeRobot training datasets.

The 200 published single-arm episodes are a subset of the 1,000 canonical episodes. Drive is a separate task-record archive. Its folders and historical recordings do not define the LeRobot training release.

Task-record archive and historical variants +

Fridge restoration, lunchbox cleanup and the current cucumber-sandwich task were not found in the inspected Drive folders. Their validated local LeRobot exports are still included in the task explorer. Archive coverage and training-data availability are tracked separately. The older lettuce-sandwich, buffer-rearrangement and layered-stocking folders are historical variants and are not counted as additional current benchmark tasks.

05 / GET STARTED

A familiar format.
Explicit task contracts.

Point the official LeRobot loader at one task root. Read that task’s action and observation metadata before configuring a policy.

Single-arm loader example · Python 3.12 · LeRobot 0.4.4

01

One episode, one video per camera

Canonical single-arm exports contain 50 videos for each of three camera views: 150 MP4s per task, at 20 Hz and 480 × 360.

02

Keep controller meanings intact

Battery, dishwasher and delivery use 7D OSC pose commands. The other single-arm tasks use 8D joint targets. Dual-arm contracts are documented per task.

03

Separate compatibility from performance

All 20 single-arm datasets passed loader and one-step ACT training checks. This release does not report learned-policy success rates or define a held-out split.
